resumeText: Mia Chen is a Platform Engineer at Vantage Commerce with three years of experience running the internal platform. She manages Kubernetes clusters, writes Terraform for cloud networking, and keeps CI/CD pipelines healthy with ArgoCD. Her automation is written in Python and Bash; she is building toward writing platform tooling in Go and taking on broader platform ownership.
